question.text: Which SDG corresponds to 'Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions'?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the SDG list on p14, SDG 16 is 'Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions'. SDG 13 is Climate Action, SDG 14 is Life Below Water, SDG 15 is Life on Land. The Trap: Options A, B and C are the environmental triad (13, 14, 15). SDG 16 is often forgotten in environmental-heavy mappings. Note: SAS 400 (per p117) covers gender equality and empowerment of women and LGBTQIA+ communities, not governance/justice — do not map SDG 16 to SAS 400.
